fb_text:
Gated community. No code.

The old move: call the owner. He's mid-dinner, mid-drive, mid-everything — digging through a text thread from March for a code he gave out once.

The new move: the tech asks the bot. The gate code's already in the log, and the log answers in seconds.

Gate's open. Nobody's phone rang. That's the job now.

I built FieldNotes for my own business — a commercial plant service company running 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area. It works because your crew already knows how to send a text. No apps, no logins, no training.

Try the 60-second demo, no signup: fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
